summary: Automate source-linked release notes, changelog coverage and support policy
details: Validate event-based security support windows and preserve withdrawal records with explicit install exclusions.
Require material source deliveries to update a versioned change fragment; generate the Unreleased section without rewriting earlier manual or published notes.
Allow an explicit no-changelog PR label only after authenticated repository, state and exact-source verification; normal pull requests may carry one fragment across their delivery.
Generate candidate notes with source inventories, API and SDK compatibility, migrations, security notices and limitations; require matching committed notes before packaging or local tagging.
Retain notes for review before release builds and environment approval, then compare packaged notes before attestation or draft publication.
Allow the initial policy PR to target its real pre-adoption master base while preserving exact ancestry and full-delivery fragment or verified-label requirements.
Document the initial normal merge, source-review checksum maintenance and dated local qualification, with hosted integration and publication limits explicit.
Align the documentation index with generated, committed candidate notes and the support/withdrawal reference.

compatibility.notes: No HTTP, SDK or database contract change. Candidate packaging now requires exact generated notes committed at docs/reference/release-notes-<tag>.md; the static fallback is retired.

security: Withdrawal selection runs before release downloads or packaging. Fragment and Git inputs are bounded and reject symlinks. Label waivers use authenticated read-only GitHub APIs with exact repository and source binding; provider payloads and publisher secrets are not logged or passed to unrelated tools.
limitations: Local checks do not prove independent review, token scope, artifact publication or hosted integration.
The earlier source snapshot remains historical development evidence and is not a newly published release.
